description: This file is a shell script used for platform-specific upgrade and configuration functions in an OpenWrt/LEDE-based Linux embedded system. It manages hardware-specific upgrade procedures, such as checking images, performing upgrades, and copying configurations based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the image for specific board types and invokes legacy SD card check if matched.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device upgrade based on the board type, invoking specific upgrade functions.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration based on the board type.
